brief: Bespoke architectural joinery and turnkey interior engineering studio based in Dhaka. Merging visionary architecture with multi-generational artisanal craft mastery across residential, commercial, and marine commissions.
criteria: Success: distinct from generic construction/real estate clichés, recognizable at 16 px, timeless monogram/emblem, embodies intersection of architectural mass and artisanal carving.

concepts.name: Chisel Block
concepts.idea: A solid architectural block with a clean, negative-space 'P' carved out — raw structural mass meeting artisanal mastery.
rationale: Monolithic rectangular footprint represents architectural foundation and structural integrity.
Precision-carved 'P' negative counter reflects high-tolerance woodworking and chisel work.
Exceptional legibility across 16 px favicon, mobile header, luxury packaging, and embossed architectural bronze plaques.

recommendation: Chisel Block provides an unmistakable silhouette that anchors PRANGON as an authoritative, high-craft atelier.
next_steps: Deploy vector masters into web application and public assets
Integrate favicon and manifest into site metadata
Produce architectural sign specs and physical stationery kit
